title: The Thorough search of the house
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：thorough　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 thorough 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the ranger wrote of ① a thorough search of the house in the survey, and everybody in the valley said at once that it was ② so thorough that nobody in the valley would go near it. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the ranger, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the thorough ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the thorough search of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey for October 1946 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too thorough to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the villager who had come to help; the thorough ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a thorough work of the pupil, and said that no villager in his right mind would call it ⑥ as thorough as the work of the pupil they had once had in the old valley. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was thorough or not, and he said so.

By 1959 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was ⑦ something thorough, and nothing besides. The villager from the next valley called the whole plan ⑧ quite thorough; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the survey kept the names of the thorough ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1962, without complaint, she wrote of another thorough search of the house in the same survey, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ no less thorough than anybody had expected. ⑩ The thorough work of the pupil that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1964, was the one she could never quite name; the thorough ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 彻底（前置定语 a thorough search of the house：1952 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的那件彻底的搜查）
B. adj. 彻底／细致（两处加强说法：so thorough that … 与 no less thorough than …）
C. adj. 彻底／细致（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 彻底（表语 too thorough to do：母亲觉得它太彻底，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 细致（前置定语 a thorough work of the pupil：叔叔把整件事称作一桩细致的作业）
F. adj. 细致（同级比较 as thorough as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩学生细致的作业相比）
G. adj. 细致（后置定语 something thorough：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 细致（受程度副词修饰 quite thorough：那位村民的评价）

items.q: a thorough search of the house
the thorough search of the house that
a thorough work of the pupil
The thorough work of the pupil that

answers.why: thorough 意为“彻底”，1952 年守林人在踏勘记录里记下的是“一件彻底的搜查”，此处作前置定语 a thorough search of the house。
thorough 意为“彻底”，此处用 so thorough that 结构，说它彻底到山谷里没人敢靠近。
thorough 意为“彻底”，踏勘记录上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的彻底对屋子的彻底搜查，等于最高级的说法。
thorough 意为“彻底”，母亲认为这件东西“太彻底了，谁也用不上”，too thorough to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
thorough 意为“细致”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩细致的作业”，此处作前置定语 a thorough work of the pupil。
thorough 意为“细致”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩学生细致的作业一样细致”，同级比较用 as thorough as。
thorough 意为“细致”，踏勘记录上那半行字要的是“细致的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something thorough。
thorough 意为“细致”，邻山谷来的那位村民认为这套计划“相当细致”，quite 修饰原级 thorough。
thorough 意为“细致”，no less thorough than 表示“其细致不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之细致不亚于任何人的预料。
thorough 意为“细致”，母亲 1964 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的细致作业”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1952 年，守林人在踏勘记录里记下了一件彻底的搜查。（a thorough search of the house）
它彻底到山谷里没有一个人敢靠近。（so thorough that …）
母亲觉得它太彻底，谁也用不上。（too thorough to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩细致的作业。（a thorough work of the pupil）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩学生细致的作业一样细致。（as thorough as …）
到了 1959 年，踏勘记录上只剩半行字：要的是一件细致的东西。（something thorough）
answers: In 1952 the ranger wrote of a thorough search of the house in the survey.
It was so thorough that nobody in the valley would go near it.
My mother thought it too thorough to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a thorough work of the pupil.
He said nobody would call it as thorough as the work of the pupil they had once had.
By 1959 the survey asked for nothing but something thorough.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 thorough 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the ranger wrote of a thorough search of the house in the survey, and nobody forgot it.
It was the thorough search of the house that anybody there had ever seen, or so the survey says.
My mother thought it too thorough to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a thorough work of the pupil, and nobody argued with him.
The villager from the next valley called the plan quite thorough, and everybody laughed.
The thorough ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
